name: vix_spike_fade_short_horizon_btc
rationale: VIX cross_up vol shocks tend to mean-revert FAST in BTC; the relief bounce is a short-horizon phenomenon. Thesis: arm long BTC-led majors on vix_level cross_up with a deliberately short hold and tight time-stop. Disconfirmer: the horizon is capped short and funding must be below a fitted ceiling — if profits require a long hold the result is trend-following not a vol-spike fade, and if the edge needs crowded-positive funding it is a carry trade; the short clock plus funding cap proves the fast vol-shock reversion.
catalyst: VIX spike cross_up, fast relief window
